description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewMetadata class within the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing display and retrieval methods related to view rendering, modules, and fields.

classes.name: ViewMetadataTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing display and data retrieval methods of the ViewMetadata class.

methods.name: testdisplayCheckBoxes
methods.description: Tests that displayCheckBoxes returns non-empty HTML content and more content when prefilled.

methods.name: testdisplaySelect
methods.description: Tests that displaySelect returns non-empty HTML content and longer content with prefilled options.

methods.name: testdisplayTextBoxes
methods.description: Tests that displayTextBoxes returns non-empty HTML content and longer content with prefilled options.

methods.name: testprintValue
methods.description: Tests that printValue outputs non-empty content for given input.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method with and without $_REQUEST parameters.

methods.name: testgetModules
methods.description: Verifies that getModules returns an array.

methods.name: testfindFieldsWithAttributes
methods.description: Checks findFieldsWithAttributes returns distinct arrays based on different attribute filters.

methods.name: testfindVardefs
methods.description: Checks findVardefs returns arrays and that different modules yield different definitions.

methods.name: testfindFieldAttributes
methods.description: Tests findFieldAttributes returns different arrays with various filtering options.
